programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot

latest_verified_ci.note: Full L0->L3 regression green. Human Vision pull-away binary engineering-proxy reward support replicated on 3 of 4 fresh independently seeded development blocks (4 hits / 976 attempts), while the first context-free one-dimensional UCB1 memory remains a verified negative held-out learning result.

governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, PLANS, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
shooting_axiom: GOOD SHOOTING IS CONTINUOUS PERCEPTUAL COUPLING BETWEEN TARGET AND GUN: READ THE LINE -> MATCH THE SPEED -> APPLY THE METHOD -> TRIGGER -> FOLLOW THROUGH.
anti_cheat_audit_status: GREEN_THROUGH_L3_PULL_AWAY_HUMAN_VISION_REWARD_REPLICATION_AT_CI_33988682722; LEARNER MEMORY IMPORTS NO ORACLE/PHYSICS/REFEREE; REPLICATION USES SAME PREDECLARED ACTION GRID ON EACH FRESH BLOCK AND PERFORMS NO POLICY SELECTION; ORACLE SCORES POST_TRIGGER_ONLY; TARGET_SEED_SCENARIO_SEED_MISS_DISTANCE_TRUE_RANGE_FUTURE_PATH_INTERCEPT_PELLET_TOF_REQUIRED_LEAD_AND_DIRECT_CORRECTION REMAIN OUTSIDE LEARNER POLICY AND MEMORY
active_hypotheses: Good shooting is continuous perceptual coupling: read the live line, match gun speed, apply method, trigger, and follow through.
Human-analogous acquisition creates an information-versus-runway trade-off: waiting may improve line/speed belief but consumes shooting opportunity.
Pull-away remains the primary L3 method because acquire/connect/match/separate/trigger/follow-through gives an interpretable adaptation loop.

Binary reward support now demonstrably exists on multiple independently seeded fresh Human Vision populations; the next uncertainty is whether learner-safe context/episodic memory can exploit it and transfer.
Ellis apprenticeship records contain learner-safe acquisition/process context that may support episodic/contextual memory without target identity or oracle geometry.
Satisfaction and affect-like variables remain experimental and must survive explicit ablation before retention.
negative_findings: Static one-dimensional maintained-lead separation had no binary reward support after expanded diagnosis; motor travel was not the primary limitation.
Shooter-visible trigger timing expansion produced 100 physical follow-through shots across 1512 attempts and zero proxy hits.
Fresh post-geometry diagnostic produced 0/660 hits; quasi-continuous constant relationship exploration produced 0/1024 hits.
Phase-dependent relationship representation did not outperform constant control: 4/1024 versus 5/1024 proxy hits on the same bank.
The first context-free one-dimensional pull-away UCB1 hit/miss memory failed held-out transfer: learned 0/3 versus no-memory uniform 1/183; memory advantage -0.00546448087431694.
Reward remains sparse even though it replicated: 4/976 hits across four fresh blocks, with one entire block producing zero hits.

Do not copy fresh-block rewarded action identities into Ellis memory, widen the hit proxy, inject referee miss gradients, expose oracle lead, or treat the 55 mm engineering proxy as real-world break probability.
Human Vision V1 numerical defaults and pull-away policy thresholds remain SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS / PROVISIONAL_METHOD_KINEMATICS pending human calibration.
next_action: Design and implement the first interpretable learner-safe contextual/episodic pull-away memory using only pre-action or learner-experienced Human Vision/acquisition/process context. Retain the context-free one-dimensional UCB1 learner as a negative baseline and compare both against no-memory exploration on distinct train/calibration/development-heldout populations. Context may include learner-visible acquisition quality/phase, confidence, observation span, presentation progress/runway and method/process state, but must exclude target seed, exact range, future trajectory, intercept, miss distance, required lead and oracle action. Do not scale to 100k until contextual memory demonstrates reproducible held-out learning advantage.
